mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE has been above 5.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in demand for goods and services, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 index, manufacturing sector weakness signals reduced corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 90.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS has increased for 6 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 550,000 units signals a cooling housing market that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansions when HOUST is below 550,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) declines and labor market strength (PAYEMS) weakens simultaneously, it signals a dual shock to the economy that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines and PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both INDPRO and PAYEMS decline for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
